source.feature_availability: available_at <= decision; entry at first later trade

execution.fee: signed GET /fapi/v1/commissionRate or labelled official config fallback

state_action.management: same parameterized management path for labels and replay

probability_heads.challenger_rule: strictly better Brier, EV calibration, EV MAE and decision regret

fold_local_experts.generator: XGBRFRegressor CUDA critic context trained on exact managed net_bps
fold_local_experts.candidate: every context leaf by side after multi-expert plan composition
fold_local_experts.compression: active-leaf managed statistics; leaves do not define the plan
fold_local_experts.fit_encoding: strict expanding chronological cross-fit with actual-exit purge

plan_generator.experts: OOF heterogeneous horizon/view return and path-quantile predictors
plan_generator.gating: robust sparse weights across views and horizons
plan_generator.plans_per_state: data-driven LONG/SHORT parameterized proposals; not ten templates
plan_generator.objective: expected gross movement, disagreement, path quantiles and Binance 1x cost
plan_generator.local_perturbations: one parameter family at a time around each expert-composed plan; enabled only by past-only local-regret audit

controller.entry_value: paired semi-Markov advantage capped by immediate expected log utility: continuation may veto an entry but cannot make a negative immediate action enter
controller.risk_stop_overrun_reserve: past-only 99.9% quantile of loss beyond initial stop plus actual 1x costs

validation.global_trials: research registry; all previously observed periods are contaminated
validation.frequency: paired Q advantage and immediate utility both positive; threshold frontier is diagnostic only; no quota

shadow_execution.source: Binance official USD-M websocket depth20@100ms routed to 1s snapshots

differences: paper uses observed L2 bid/ask and depth
historical partial fills and queue position are unavailable
